FROM THE HEART

A little letter for you

Happy Birthday, my love ❤️ Even from this far away, I feel just as close to you as I would if you were right here.

Your smile, the way you worry about me, that daily "did you eat?" — that's what gets me through every single day.

I just hope we meet soon, and once we do, we never have to be this far apart again.

— yours, always

See you soon, Rashi 💗

Until then, this little page will remind you how much someone out there misses you.

You told me you wanted a cake just like this — the book one — for your birthday. I couldn't make that happen for real this year, and I'm sorry for that. Distance made it hard to do the little things I wish I could just show up and do for you.

But I promise, one day I'll get you the real thing, in person, no screens in between. Until then — Happy Birthday, most special girl. 💗

for Rashi Singh Parihar, with love
